info.title: Meldiq API
info.description: The canonical contract of the Meldiq server (docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_1_0_PLAN.md §4), generated from src/shared/contracts. Fields are only ever added within a version; clients ignore unknown fields. Routes not listed here exist but aren't documented yet.

get.summary: Liveness and database reachability (503 when MongoDB is unreachable).
What this server is and supports.

post.summary: Send an encrypted envelope: fanned out into each recipient device's delivery queue. Idempotent on messageId.

default.description: Error. Codes: not_found, forbidden, timed_out, voice_channel, bad_clock, conflict, bad_signature, slowmode, request_pending, request_limit, mention_all_not_in_dm, mention_all_not_allowed, mention_all_rate_limited, device_mismatch, federation_disabled

get.summary: This device's queued items in order (the REST fallback for the WebSocket queue).

post.summary: Acknowledge queue items: they are deleted and the senders get delivery receipts.

get.summary: The account's encrypted history: counts, size and limits.

put.summary: Add, replace or mark deleted encrypted history items. All or nothing.

default.description: Error. Codes: history_off, too_large, quota_exceeded, history_full

get.summary: Items written after a cursor, oldest write first.

delete.summary: Delete the account's whole history from the server.

post.summary: Upload an encrypted file in one request through the server (small files; large ones use /v1/attachments/uploads).

default.description: Error. Codes: not_found, forbidden, too_large, storage_full, too_many_uploads, quota_exceeded

get.summary: Download an attachment's ciphertext (supports Range), or a redirect to a short-lived storage URL.

200.description: The bytes (or 302 to a storage URL)

post.summary: Keep an attachment longer than the queue lifetime (when the server allows it).
Start a direct upload to storage: one presigned PUT, or a multipart upload.

default.description: Error. Codes: not_found, forbidden, too_large, storage_full, too_many_uploads, quota_exceeded, direct_upload_unavailable, storage_unavailable

post.summary: A fresh presigned PUT for a single-mode upload (the first one expired).
Presign parts of a multipart upload (at most 100 per request).

get.summary: The parts storage already has (to resume an interrupted upload).

post.summary: Finish an upload: checked against its size and checksums, then usable in an envelope. Idempotent.

default.description: Error. Codes: not_found, forbidden, not_uploaded, upload_incomplete, upload_corrupt, upload_expired, storage_unavailable

post.summary: Start a call in a conversation, or join the one already live there.

default.description: Error. Codes: not_found, conflict, request_pending, media_unavailable, text_channel_no_calls, call_full, forbidden

get.summary: Live calls in this person's conversations (to recover missed rings).
A conversation's call history, newest first.

post.summary: Join a live call: the media grant for this device.

default.description: Error. Codes: not_found, call_ended, call_full, media_unavailable, forbidden

post.summary: Voice rooms: raise or lower your hand.
Voice rooms: a moderator mutes someone, lowers their hand or removes them from the call.
This device's media connected (the call becomes active).
This device is ringing (the caller sees Ringing).
Decline a ringing call, or say you're busy.
End the call for everyone (1:1) or leave it (group).

allow_and_deny.meaning: An overwrite can't both allow and deny "…"

already_migrated.meaning: This account has already moved to email sign-in. Sign in with ….

application_required.meaning: This community asks a few questions first: apply to join

archived.meaning: This role is archived. Restore it before assigning it.

bad_clock.meaning: Device clock is too far off

bad_signature.meaning: A signature doesn't verify (a message envelope against its device, or a federated request against its server).

bad_username.meaning: The username isn't valid (length or characters).

banned.meaning: You've been banned from this community

beyond_your_powers.meaning: You can only change "…" if you hold it yourself

call_failed.meaning: A federated call's host server refused the request.

call_full.meaning: This call is full (… people at most)

category_has_permissions.meaning: This category's permissions decide who sees its channels. Move its channels out (or delete them) first.

challenge_expired.meaning: The sign-in took too long. Try again.

channel_not_found.meaning: Pick a channel of this community

channel_not_public.meaning: Onboarding can only open this community's public channels

confirm_mismatch.meaning: Type your account's email address exactly to delete your account. Nothing was deleted.

conflict.meaning: The request conflicts with the current state.

delegation_required.meaning: You need the power to hand out roles to do that.

device_key_retired.meaning: These device keys can't be used again. The app will make new ones.

device_mismatch.meaning: Recipient devices changed; refresh keys and retry

device_required.meaning: Only a device that has this account's keys can back them up.

device_revoked.meaning: This phone was removed from your account. Set up encryption again.

direct_upload_unavailable.meaning: This server receives uploads itself: use POST /v1/attachments.

dm_not_allowed.meaning: This person only accepts messages from people they're connected with

dms_paused.meaning: New direct messages between members of your community are paused for now

email_failed.meaning: We couldn't send the email just now. Try again in a minute.

email_in_use.meaning: Another account uses that address. Choose a different one.

email_taken.meaning: That email already has a Meldiq account. Use another address, or sign in with it.

email_unavailable.meaning: This server can't send email right now. Use your recovery key or another signed-in device.

email_unverified.meaning: Verify your email first: enter the code we sent you.

federated_calls_unavailable.meaning: Calls with people on other servers aren't available yet

federation_backlog.meaning: The other person's server isn't keeping up. Try again later.

forbidden.meaning: You can't post in this conversation

grant_and_deny.meaning: A role can't both grant and restrict the same permission.

history_full.meaning: This server's message history storage is full. Try again later.

history_off.meaning: This server doesn't keep message history.

holder_out_of_reach.meaning: Someone holding this role is an admin or has powers you don't, so only an owner can change what it does

identity_exists.meaning: This account already has encryption keys. Try again.

identity_mismatch.meaning: This account already has encryption keys. Restore them with your recovery key or from another device, or start fresh.

identity_required.meaning: This account has no encryption keys yet: send the new identity key

internal.meaning: Something went wrong on the server.

invalid_certificate.meaning: This device's certificate isn't signed by the account's identity key

invalid_code.meaning: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.

invalid_credentials.meaning: That email and password don't match an account.

invalid_device_proof.meaning: This phone's keys don't belong to this account. Set up encryption again.

invalid_invite.meaning: This invitation code is invalid, expired or already used

invalid_recovery.meaning: That email and recovery code don't match an account, or the code was already used.

invalid_ticket.meaning: This step took too long. Start again with your username and recovery key.

invite_required.meaning: Signing up needs an invitation code

invite_revoked.meaning: The invite was cancelled by whoever created it.

invite_unavailable.meaning: Whoever created the invite can no longer invite people there.

invite_used_up.meaning: The invite has been used as many times as it allows.

invites_paused.meaning: This community has paused new members for now. Try again later.

leave_community.meaning: Leave the community instead of one of its channels

legacy_login_closed.meaning: This version of the app can't sign in any more. Update the app and sign in with your email.

legacy_registration_closed.meaning: This version of the app can't create accounts any more. Update the app to sign up.

legacy_verification_failed.meaning: That username and recovery key don't match an account. Check both and try again.

limit_reached.meaning: … ……, and this workspace has reached it.

login_throttled.meaning: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.

media_unavailable.meaning: Calling is not configured on this server

mention_all_not_allowed.meaning: Only admins and managers can mention everyone in this conversation.

mention_all_rate_limited.meaning: @everyone was used here too often in the last hour.

migration_closed.meaning: Moving older accounts has ended on this server.

no_key_backup.meaning: There's no key backup for this account's current password. Use your recovery key or another signed-in device.

not_archived.meaning: Archive the role before deleting it

not_found.meaning: Not found, or not visible to you.

not_uploaded.meaning: The file hasn't reached the server's storage yet. Upload it again.

onboarding_off.meaning: This community doesn't ask onboarding questions

org_name_taken.meaning: You already own a community called "…". Open it, or choose another name.

org_quota_exceeded.meaning: This workspace has reached its file storage limit. Older files expire after 7 days.

own_report.meaning: This report is about you: another moderator handles it

owner_only.meaning: Only the owner can do that.

owns_workspaces.meaning: You're the only owner of a workspace. Make someone else an owner, or delete the workspace, first. Nothing was deleted.

push_endpoint_invalid.meaning: The push endpoint must be an https:// address without credentials or #fragment.

push_host_not_allowed.meaning: This server only sends wake-ups to its own push server.

push_unavailable.meaning: This server doesn't send push wake-ups

quota_exceeded.meaning: New accounts can upload … a day for their first … days (… left today).

range_not_satisfiable.meaning: The requested byte range is outside the file.

rate_limited.meaning: Too many requests, slow down (the Retry-After header says when).

recovery_throttled.meaning: Too many wrong recovery codes. Wait a while and try again.

registration_limited.meaning: Too many new accounts from this network. Try again later, or ask for an invitation code.

registration_paused.meaning: New sign-ups are paused for now. Try again later, or ask for an invitation code.

report_limit.meaning: You've sent a lot of reports in the last hour. Try again later.

request_limit.meaning: You can send more once they accept your message request

request_pending.meaning: Calls start once the message request is accepted

request_rate_limited.meaning: You've sent a lot of requests. Try again in an hour.

requests_not_allowed.meaning: This person isn't accepting connection requests

role_name_taken.meaning: A role called "…" already exists in this workspace

role_not_givable.meaning: Onboarding can only give this community's roles without administrative permissions

same_email.meaning: That's the address the account already uses. Sign in with it, or reset your password.

session_expired.meaning: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

session_revoked.meaning: This session was signed out. Sign in again.

slowmode.meaning: Slowmode is on in this channel. Wait a moment before posting again.

stale.meaning: Someone else changed this role. Review the latest version and try again.

stale_preferences.meaning: These preferences changed on another device. Apply your change to this copy and try again.

stale_reminder.meaning: This reminder changed on another device.

stale_revision.meaning: Someone changed this meeting meanwhile. Reload it and try again.

storage_full.meaning: File storage for new accounts is full right now. Try again later.

storage_unavailable.meaning: The server couldn't store the photo. Try again in a moment.

text_channel_no_calls.meaning: Calls happen in voice rooms, not in text channels

timed_out.meaning: You're timed out in this community until …

too_many_attempts.meaning: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.

too_many_devices.meaning: This account has as many devices as it can have. Remove one you no longer use (Settings › Devices).

too_many_reminders.meaning: You can have up to … reminders waiting. Finish or delete some first.

too_many_uploads.meaning: You've started a lot of uploads in the last hour. Try again later.

unavailable.meaning: The server can't check your session right now. Try again in a moment.

upload_corrupt.meaning: The stored file doesn't match what was announced. Send it again.

upload_expired.meaning: This upload took too long. Start it again.

upload_incomplete.meaning: Part … isn't uploaded yet, or differs. Upload it again.

username_recently_changed.meaning: You can change your username once an hour

username_taken.meaning: That username is already taken. Try again.

weak_password.meaning: The password doesn't meet the length or strength rules.

bad_body_hash.meaning: A signed request's body doesn't match its hash.

bad_call.meaning: The federated call request is malformed.

bad_descriptor.meaning: The peer server's descriptor doesn't verify.

bad_nonce.meaning: A signed request's nonce is invalid.

bad_response_signature.meaning: The peer server's answer isn't signed correctly.

bad_time.meaning: A signed request's time is too far off.

id_conflict.meaning: An id is already used with different content.

insecure_peer.meaning: The peer server isn't reachable over a secure connection.

lookup_failed.meaning: The peer server couldn't be reached.

lookup_mismatch.meaning: The peer server's answer doesn't match the request.

not_allowed.meaning: The peer server isn't allowed to do that.

not_host.meaning: The server isn't the call's host.

not_shared.meaning: The conversation isn't shared with that server.

not_your_user.meaning: The user doesn't belong to the requesting server.

peer_refused.meaning: The other server refused the request.

self.meaning: That address is on this server.

server_not_active.meaning: The server isn't active in the network.

server_unresolvable.meaning: The registry couldn't resolve the server.

unknown_domain.meaning: No server answers for that domain.

unknown_server.meaning: The server isn't known to the network.

unsigned.meaning: The request isn't signed by a server.

wrong_destination.meaning: The request was meant for another server.
